Job Description:
Position Overview
We are seeking a highly motivated PCB Layout Automation Intern to support automation and tool development efforts within our networking hardware engineering team.
This role is ideal for a student interested in combining hardware design with programming. The intern will gain hands-on experience developing automation tools using Cadence Allegro PCB Designer and the SKILL , while supporting high-speed PCB layout projects for networking platforms such as switches and routers.
You will work closely with senior PCB engineers to improve workflow efficiency, create reusable tools, and help standardize layout processes.
Responsibilities:
Primary Focus: Automation & Tool Development
Assist in developing and testing SKILL-based automation utilities
Modify and enhance existing SKILL scripts for:
Differential pair validation
Length matching reports
Constraint audits
Design rule automation
Create simple custom Allegro forms (GUI elements) using SKILL
Develop reporting tools for layout metrics and quality checks
Document scripting workflows and best practices
Support integration of Allegro automation with external scripts (Python or batch tools)
Secondary Exposure: PCB Layout Support
Assist with basic routing and placement tasks
Run design rule checks (DRC) and analyze results
Support engineering change orders (ECOs)
Observe high-speed routing methodologies for Ethernet, PCIe, and DDR interfaces
Gain exposure to stack-up design and impedance control principles
Education & Experience:
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
Coursework in programming (data structures, scripting, or software fundamentals)
Strong interest in combining software development with hardware design
Analytical mindset and problem-solving ability
Knowledge & Skills:
Exposure to SKILL
Familiarity with Cadence Allegro PCB Designer
Experience with Python, Tcl, or other scripting languages
Participation in robotics, FPGA, PCB, or hardware-related student projects
Interest in high-speed networking systems
What You’ll Gain
Real-world experience developing engineering automation tools
Exposure to professional PCB design environments
Understanding of high-speed networking hardware platforms
Mentorship from senior layout and SI engineers
Practical application of programming in hardware development workflows
Ideal Candidate Traits
Curious about how tools work under the hood
Enjoys building utilities that improve team productivity
Detail-oriented and methodical
Comfortable debugging both code and engineering workflows
